_about: Hand-maintained part library for printer_stiffness.py / validate_model.py. Every *.json in this folder is merged (later files override earlier keys). duender_generated.json is written by build_library.py from the repo CAD; edit THIS file for materials, print settings and name rules. Units: mm, MPa, kg/mm^3.

steel.desc: Steel (linear rails, carriages, lead screws, T-brackets)

motor.desc: Stepper motor treated as a stiff block (NEMA17 42-40 about 280 g)

silicone.desc: Silicone bed spacers (very soft on purpose)

asa.desc: ASA - Duender default for load-bearing printed parts

abs.desc: ABS - equal to ASA for the Duender parts

pet_cf.desc: PET-CF - manual: low-creep choice for docks, tensioners, Z/bed mounts (check your brand's datasheet)

pa_cf.desc: PA-CF - stiff when dry but the manual says avoid: it creeps

petg.desc: PETG - not specified by the Duender manuals

pla.desc: PLA - manual: only for the electronics case and screen box

duender_load_bearing.source: Duender manuals Ch 1 Step 1.4: ASA/ABS, 5/5/5, 60% (min 50%) gyroid for load-bearing parts

medusahc.source: Duender manuals Ch 1 / Ch 12: MedusaHC parts ABS/ASA at 98% infill (Sergei)

box.source: Duender manuals Ch 1: 15% is fine for boxes

printed_model._about: E_eff = E * (shell + (1-shell) * infill^infill_exponent) * layer_factor, shell = min(1, 2 * walls * line_width / thinnest part dimension). Estimate only.

part_rules.match: middle mount|bed mount|bed holder|z motor mount|motor mount|tensioner|y front|y back|\bx [12]\b|x_carriage|carriage_lite|carriage_bases|toolhead|idler|printed|\bprint\b

_unmatched: Bodies matching no rule use --default-material (aluminum) unless their name says otherwise.
